description: This is a Python source file containing self-test cases for image features in the oeqa (OpenEmbedded QA) testing framework. It defines a class 'ImageFeatures' with multiple test methods to verify various image build and configuration features such as SSH connectivity, Wayland support, bmap support, hypervisor formats, chain conversions, image types, static user addition, busybox replacement, debug filesystem generation, and empty image creation.

classes.name: ImageFeatures
classes.description: A test case class for verifying image features in OpenEmbedded images.

methods.name: test_non_root_user_can_connect_via_ssh_without_password
methods.description: Tests SSH connectivity for root and non-root users without passwords in a built image.

methods.name: test_all_users_can_connect_via_ssh_without_password
methods.description: Verifies that only non-root users can connect via SSH without passwords, and root cannot.

methods.name: test_wayland_support_in_image
methods.description: Checks if Wayland support can be built and installed in the image.

methods.name: test_bmap
methods.description: Validates support for bmap images, their sparsity, and gzip integrity.

methods.name: test_hypervisor_fmts
methods.description: Ensures support for various hypervisor image formats and verifies their correctness with qemu-img.

methods.name: test_long_chain_conversion
methods.description: Tests chaining multiple image conversion commands and verifying sha256 sums.

methods.name: test_image_fstypes
methods.description: Builds images with various supported image file types and checks their existence.

methods.name: test_useradd_static
methods.description: Tests static user addition configuration in image build.

methods.name: test_no_busybox_base_utils
methods.description: Verifies replacement of busybox with systemd and other utils in the build.

methods.name: test_image_gen_debugfs
methods.description: Checks debug filesystem generation, extraction, and symbol verification.

methods.name: test_empty_image
methods.description: Creates an image with no packages and verifies the manifest is empty.
